import math
import torch

sample_rate, n_fft, hop, bands = 16000, 400, 160, 16
time = torch.arange(1600) / sample_rate
wave = torch.cat([0.5 * torch.sin(2 * math.pi * f * time) for f in [440, 880]])
# 重列12.6–12.8的固定前處理，讓本格可直接執行。
mels = torch.linspace(0, 2595 * math.log10(1 + 8000 / 700), bands + 2)
hz = 700 * (10 ** (mels / 2595) - 1)
frequency = torch.linspace(0, 8000, n_fft // 2 + 1)
left = (frequency[None] - hz[:-2, None]) / (hz[1:-1] - hz[:-2])[:, None]
right = (hz[2:, None] - frequency[None]) / (hz[2:] - hz[1:-1])[:, None]
bank = torch.minimum(left, right).clamp(min=0)
spectrum = torch.stft(
    wave, n_fft, hop, window=torch.hann_window(n_fft), center=True, pad_mode="reflect", return_complex=True
)
sequence = (bank @ spectrum.abs().square()).clamp(min=1e-8).log().T
reordered = sequence.flip(0)  # 倒轉已取得的特徵框，不重算倒放波形。
print("時間框與頻帶", *sequence.shape)
print("先後序列相同", torch.equal(sequence, reordered))
print("平均摘要近似相同", torch.allclose(sequence.mean(0), reordered.mean(0)))

derivations.sampling: N=1600, fs=16000 samples/s, duration=N/fs=0.1 s; concatenation N=3200, duration=0.2 s. Sample-time last index is 1599/fs; not an extra endpoint.
derivations.shapes: real one-sided STFT F=400//2+1=201; center=True gives T=1+3200//160=21. Bank [16,201] @ power [201,21] gives [16,21], T swaps to [21,16].
derivations.mean_invariance: For finite T>0, mu_j=(1/T) sum_{t=0}^{T-1} x[t,j]. For any permutation pi, sum_t x[pi(t),j]=sum_t x[t,j], so the exact-real mu is unchanged. Floating addition may differ in its last bits. This concerns features without order already encoded before pooling.
derivations.order_task: Take L=[1,0], H=[0,1]. [L,H] and [H,L] both average to [.5,.5] but the high-first label differs. Any deterministic downstream function seeing only this mean has the same input for both and cannot distinguish their order.
derivations.presence_exercise: Under the restricted illustrative family [L,L] versus [L,H], means [1,0] versus [.5,.5] can distinguish whether H occurred. This is possibility, not a general detector or learned accuracy result.
derivations.order_vs_time: Ordered indices [0,1] are compatible with physical anchors [100,200] ms and [1000,2000] ms. An order-preserving transformation t -> a*t+b with a>0 retains order but changes physical time. Knowing order alone does not identify elapsed milliseconds.
derivations.supervision: If the intended answer changes when order changes, the target objective must distinguish those cases to require using order. Suitable labels are a task requirement, not proof that optimization succeeds.
derivations.transcript_vs_answer: A string error can preserve information sufficient for a task answer, and two differently ordered syllable sequences can demand different transcripts. Therefore transcript matching and task answering require separate criteria.
